title: Binance Sets Aside $6.34 Billion to Cover Hack Losses
description: Binance said it has reserved more than $6.34 billion in company funds to restore customer balances after attackers stole an estimated $6.3 billion, with about $5 billion already held in the affected tokens and a withdrawal restart targeted within about 34 hours.

title: CoinDCX Puts Futures Into Reduce-Only Mode After Binance Disruption
description: CoinDCX restricted new futures positions on Oct. 30 after Binance's security incident disrupted a liquidity provider, then reopened most markets the same day while four tokens stayed limited.

title: House Oversight Chair Opens Investigation of Delaware Plan for AI-Run Companies
description: Rep. James Comer asked Delaware's governor for documents on the state's proposed Artificial Intelligence Company structure, warning it could shield AI companies and their investors from liability for harms caused by the agents running the firms.

title: CFTC Frontier Forum presses who is liable when AI agents trade
description: At the CFTC's first Frontier Forum on Oct. 28, Chairman Michael Selig and panelists debated whether developers, operators or customers bear responsibility when autonomous trading software breaks market rules.

title: CZ cites billion-dollar SpaceX stake in reply to Musk after Binance hack
description: Changpeng Zhao told Elon Musk that Binance holds more than $1 billion in SPCX shares from its $500 million Twitter investment, while co-founder Yi He said annual revenue covers the $6.3 billion hack losses without selling the stake.
